Per-horizon top-k (k=3, smape) on full pool: leverages unstable ranking by letting different models lead at different horizon steps, suited to trend-dominated series where no single model dominates all 13 steps

Softmax weighting provides smooth concentration on better models while retaining all 19; tests whether a gentler concentration than inverse_error but more focused than trimmed_mean helps with unstable ranking (tau=0.212) in this trend-dominated series

Caruana forward selection: picks models greedily for error complementarity, testing whether a small diversified subset beats full-pool robust aggregation under unstable ranking (tau=0.212) and high correlation (0.823)

Median on top-7 pool: robust aggregation on a curated subset to remove worst models while avoiding over-weighting any single model, testing whether pool quality + robustness beats full-pool robustness

Simplest baseline to test whether trimming (leader) adds value over plain arithmetic mean; trend-dominated high-predictability series should have well-aligned models
